# TropiBlend

> TropiBlend is a Filipino gourmet condiment brand from Cagayan de Oro City (CDO), Misamis Oriental, Philippines. It makes small-batch salsas, pickles, pesto and salad dressing from fresh and natural ingredients, with no artificial preservatives.

## Products

- Pineapple Salsa (500 ml jar): pineapple, bell pepper, onion, lime, cane sugar, salt, pepper, herbs and spices. Good with chips, grilled pork, grilled fish and tacos.
- Mango Salsa (500 ml jar): mango, bell pepper, onion, lime, cane sugar, salt, pepper, herbs and spices. Good with grilled fish, chicken, seafood, tacos and salads.
- Pickled Cucumber (500 ml jar): Japanese cucumber, dill, lime, cane sugar, salt, pepper, herbs and spices. Good with inihaw, lechon manok, burgers and rice meals.
- Pickled Onion (350 ml jar): bright pink pickled onion rings with cane sugar, salt, pepper, herbs and spices. Good with grilled meats, fried chicken, burgers, sandwiches and tacos.
- Pesto (300 ml jar): basil, parmesan cheese, extra virgin olive oil, cashew nuts, herbs and spices. Contains tree nuts (cashew) and dairy. Good with pasta, toast and grilled meats.
- Mango Salad Dressing (350 ml bottle): mango, lime, cane sugar, salt, pepper, herbs and spices. Good with green salads, avocado and chicken bowls.

## Where to buy and how to order

- Order by Facebook Messenger (https://m.me/TropiBlendph), call or text 0956 447 9961, or email elsie@tropiblend.com. TropiBlend confirms availability, price and pickup or delivery details within Cagayan de Oro.
- TropiBlend joined the MSME fair at SM CDO Downtown starting September 9, 2026. Current fairs and pop-ups are announced on https://www.facebook.com/TropiBlendph.

## Blog: answers and serving ideas

- [What Is TropiBlend? Gourmet Condiments Made in Cagayan de Oro](https://tropiblend.com/blog/what-is-tropiblend/): TropiBlend is a Filipino food brand from Cagayan de Oro City that makes six small-batch gourmet condiments: Pineapple Salsa, Mango Salsa, Pickled Cucumber, Pickled Onion, Pesto and Mango Salad Dressing. Everything is made from fresh and natural ingredients with no artificial preservatives, and you can order directly through Facebook Messenger, by phone or by email.
- [Where to Buy TropiBlend in Cagayan de Oro (CDO)](https://tropiblend.com/blog/where-to-buy-tropiblend-cagayan-de-oro/): You can buy TropiBlend in Cagayan de Oro by ordering directly: message TropiBlendph on Facebook, call or text 0956 447 9961, or email elsie@tropiblend.com, and we'll confirm pickup or delivery details. We also sell in person at local fairs and pop-ups, including the MSME fair at SM CDO Downtown that started September 9, 2026. Upcoming events are posted on our Facebook page.
- [How to Order TropiBlend: Messenger, Phone, Email or Form](https://tropiblend.com/blog/how-to-order-tropiblend/): To order TropiBlend, send the products and quantities you want by Facebook Messenger (TropiBlendph), call or text 0956 447 9961, email elsie@tropiblend.com, or use the order form on tropiblend.com. We reply to confirm availability, price and pickup or delivery details in Cagayan de Oro.
- [What to Eat With Mango Salsa: 10 Easy Ideas](https://tropiblend.com/blog/what-to-eat-with-mango-salsa/): Mango salsa is best with grilled fish, shrimp and other seafood, grilled or fried chicken, tacos, and green salads. It also works as a dip with tortilla chips or crackers and as a fresh topping for rice bowls. Its sweet-tangy flavor cuts through smoky, salty and rich food, which is why it goes so well with Filipino grilled dishes.
- [What to Eat With Pineapple Salsa: Fish, Tacos, Pork and More](https://tropiblend.com/blog/what-to-eat-with-pineapple-salsa/): Pineapple salsa goes best with grilled fish, shrimp tacos, grilled and fried pork like liempo or lechon kawali, and as a dip with tortilla chips or crackers. Its sweet-and-tangy pineapple flavor balances salty, smoky and fatty food, making it a natural partner for Filipino grilled dishes.
- [12 Ways to Use Pickled Onions (Beyond Burgers)](https://tropiblend.com/blog/ways-to-use-pickled-onions/): Pickled onions add crunch, tang and color to almost any savory dish. Use them on burgers and sandwiches, with inihaw and lechon manok, on fried chicken, in tacos, beside tapsilog and other silog meals, on salads and avocado toast, and on pizza or nachos. TropiBlend Pickled Onion comes ready to eat in a 350 ml jar.
- [How to Use Pesto: 12 Ideas Beyond Pasta](https://tropiblend.com/blog/ways-to-use-pesto/): Besides pasta, use pesto as a spread on toast, pandesal and sandwiches, a marinade or topping for grilled chicken, pork and fish, a pizza sauce, a stir-in for scrambled eggs and soups, a dip mixed with mayo or cream cheese, and a dressing for potato salad or roasted vegetables. TropiBlend Pesto is made with basil, parmesan, extra virgin olive oil and cashew nuts.
- [Best Condiments for Inihaw: Beyond Toyomansi and Suka](https://tropiblend.com/blog/best-condiments-for-inihaw/): The best condiments for inihaw balance smoky, salty grilled meat with something tangy and fresh. Alongside the classic toyomansi and spiced vinegar, try pickled onion and pickled cucumber with liempo and pork BBQ, pineapple salsa with pork, and mango salsa with grilled fish and chicken. Serve two or three so everyone can mix and match.
- [Food Gift and Pasalubong Ideas From Cagayan de Oro](https://tropiblend.com/blog/food-gift-ideas-cagayan-de-oro/): For a unique pasalubong or food gift from Cagayan de Oro, try locally made gourmet condiments like TropiBlend's Mango Salsa, Pineapple Salsa, Pickled Cucumber, Pickled Onion, Pesto and Mango Salad Dressing. They're made in CDO from fresh, natural ingredients, look good in their labeled jars, and are something the recipient will actually use. Order by Messenger or at 0956 447 9961.
- [Pickled Cucumber vs Atchara: What's the Difference?](https://tropiblend.com/blog/pickled-cucumber-vs-atchara/): Atchara is the classic Filipino pickle made mainly from grated green papaya and is usually sweet. TropiBlend Pickled Cucumber is made from crunchy Japanese cucumber with dill and lime, so it's crisper, fresher and more herby. Both do the same job on the plate, cutting through rich, grilled and fried food, so you can use pickled cucumber anywhere you'd serve atchara.
